text.offer: South of Berg the land dies: the Valley of Death, where daemon-bound skeletons walk the slopes and the barren stretches. They creep closer to my city every year. Destroy ten of them there.
text.progress: The daemon skeletons walk the hopeless slopes and the barren stretches of the Valley of Death.
text.complete: Ten fewer horrors at my borders. Berg thanks you.

steps.objective: Daemon skeletons destroyed in the Valley of Death
